name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-albatoss-bomb
title: Redrawn Styled Albatoss + Bomb
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Mikeyk's Super Mario Bros. 2's Albatoss + Bomb custom sprite recreation, as well for Iceguy's boss version of the enemy, meant to make the bird resemble its official concept art.

Most of the variations included contain various versions of the custom sprite bomb included with the sprites.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.
